about: The Antiochian Orthodox Christian Archdiocese of North America is part of the Orthodox Patriarchate of Antioch and All the East, one of the ancient patriarchates of the Church.
Antioch is where the disciples were first called Christians (Acts 11:26). The Church there was founded by the Apostles, and St. Peter was its first bishop.

In North America the Archdiocese grew from the work of St. Raphael of Brooklyn, who cared for Orthodox immigrants from the Middle East more than a century ago. Today it has eight dioceses and more than 275 churches and missions across the United States and Canada, welcoming people of every background.
Its headquarters are in Englewood, New Jersey.

patriarch.name: His Beatitude JOHN X
patriarch.title: Patriarch of Antioch and All the East
patriarch.prayer: For His Beatitude JOHN X, Patriarch of Antioch, and for the Church of Antioch in the Middle East: for peace in her lands and strength for all her faithful.

metropolitan.name: His Eminence Metropolitan SABA
metropolitan.title: Archbishop of New York and Metropolitan of All North America
metropolitan.prayer: For His Eminence Metropolitan SABA: that the Lord grant him health, long life and wisdom in shepherding our Archdiocese.

dioceses.name: Diocese of New York and Washington, D.C.
dioceses.region: The New York City and Washington, D.C. areas, and Archdiocese institutions such as the Antiochian Village in Pennsylvania
dioceses.note: Its Mother Cathedral, St. Nicholas, is in Brooklyn.

dioceses.name: Diocese of Oakland, Charleston and the Mid-Atlantic
dioceses.region: Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia

dioceses.name: Diocese of Ottawa, Eastern Canada and Upstate New York
dioceses.region: Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Quebec and New York

dioceses.name: Diocese of Worcester and New England
dioceses.note: Its cathedral is in Worcester, Massachusetts.

dioceses.name: Diocese of Miami and the Southeast
dioceses.region: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee

dioceses.name: Diocese of Toledo and the Midwest
dioceses.role: Archiepiscopal vicar, caring for the diocese on the Metropolitan's behalf
dioceses.region: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Ohio and Wisconsin

dioceses.name: Diocese of Wichita and Mid-America
dioceses.role: Archiepiscopal vicar, caring for the diocese on the Metropolitan's behalf
dioceses.region: Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Texas and Wyoming

dioceses.name: Diocese of Los Angeles and the West
dioceses.note: Its camp, Camp St. Nicholas, is in the mountains of Frazier Park, California.

ministries.name: Antiochian Women
ministries.about: Parish chapters of women who meet for fellowship, prayer and charity, and raise funds each year for a chosen cause.
ministries.prayer: For the Antiochian Women, and for their work of charity and fellowship in every parish.

ministries.name: Teen SOYO
ministries.about: The Archdiocese's youth organization, drawing teenagers deeper into the life, worship and service of the Church.
ministries.prayer: For our young people in Teen SOYO, and for all who guide them.

ministries.name: Young Adult Ministry
ministries.about: Worship, study and retreats that connect college students and young professionals across the Archdiocese.
ministries.prayer: For college students and young adults, that they may keep the faith and grow in it.

ministries.name: Antiochian Village
ministries.about: The Archdiocese's camp and its conference and retreat center, in the Laurel Highlands of western Pennsylvania.
ministries.prayer: For the Antiochian Village, its campers, counselors and staff, and all who come there to pray and rest.

ministries.name: Camping
ministries.about: Nine camps across North America where young people live the faith together in fellowship and fun.
ministries.prayer: For our camps, and for every child and counselor who spends a summer in them.

ministries.name: Christian Education
ministries.about: Resources and support for church schools, teachers and parents, and the yearly Creative Arts Festival.
ministries.prayer: For church school teachers and for parents, as they hand on the faith to our children.

ministries.name: Sacred Music
ministries.about: Music, workshops and training for the chanters and choirs who lead the Church's worship.
ministries.prayer: For chanters, choir directors and singers, who lift up our prayer in song.

ministries.name: Missions and Evangelism
ministries.about: Planting new churches and helping young missions grow into parishes across North America.
ministries.prayer: For our missions and their priests, and for all who are coming to the Orthodox faith.

ministries.name: Charitable Outreach
ministries.about: Food for Hungry People, the Children's Relief Fund and grants that help parishes serve those in need.
ministries.prayer: For the hungry, the poor and orphaned children, and for all who serve them in Christ's name.

ministries.name: The Order of St. Ignatius of Antioch
ministries.about: A fellowship of clergy and laity whose gifts support the work and ministries of the Archdiocese.
ministries.prayer: For the members of the Order of St. Ignatius, and for all who give to support the Church's work.

ministries.name: Antiochian House of Studies
ministries.about: Distance learning in Orthodox theology, from the St. Stephen's Course to master's and doctoral degrees.
ministries.prayer: For students of theology and their teachers, and for those preparing to serve the Church.

ministries.name: St. Athanasius College and Academy
ministries.about: Online classes in Orthodox theological studies, and an academy for homeschooling families.
ministries.prayer: For Orthodox schools and homeschooling families, and for all who teach.

ministries.name: Chaplains and Pastoral Counseling
ministries.about: Retreats, workshops and courses that support the Archdiocese's chaplains and pastoral counselors.
ministries.prayer: For chaplains and pastoral counselors, and for all they care for.

ministries.name: Prison Ministry
ministries.about: Care for people in prison and their families, and help for young people at risk.
ministries.prayer: For those in prison and their families, and for all who visit them.

ministries.name: Marriage and Parish Family Ministries
ministries.about: Resources and gatherings that strengthen marriages and family life in our parishes.
ministries.prayer: For husbands and wives, for parents and children, and for every family in our parishes.

ministries.name: Monasteries
ministries.about: The monastic communities of the Archdiocese, places of prayer that welcome visitors and pilgrims.
ministries.prayer: For the monks and nuns of our monasteries, who pray for us all.

ministries.name: Western Rite Vicariate
ministries.about: Over 20 churches that worship with Western European forms of the Orthodox services.
ministries.prayer: For the parishes of the Western Rite, and for their clergy and faithful.

ministries.name: Fellowship of St. Julian
ministries.about: A fellowship for Orthodox doctors, nurses and other medical professionals.
ministries.prayer: For doctors, nurses and all who care for the sick.

ministries.name: The WORD magazine
ministries.about: The official magazine of the Archdiocese since 1905, sent to Antiochian households.
ministries.prayer: For the writers and editors who share the life of the Church through The WORD.

ministries.name: Ancient Faith Ministries
ministries.about: Books, radio, podcasts and other media that teach and share the Orthodox faith.
ministries.prayer: For all who share the Orthodox faith through books, radio and podcasts.
